name: tars
description: TARS and its extensions: a harness for personal agents, and the capabilities that plug into it.

plugins.name: tars
plugins.description: A harness for a personal agent: identity, law, memory and a self-extending skill library in one git repo, wired into every Claude Code and Codex session and updated without ever overwriting what you wrote.

plugins.name: people-memory
plugins.description: A private people graph that gives your agent durable memory of everyone you know. MCP tools to search, remember and connect people, plus skills that record them during ordinary conversation. Postgres behind it, self-hostable.

plugins.name: location-memory
plugins.description: A private location archive that gives your agent durable memory of where you have been: stays, cities, countries, trips, journeys and records, with the gaps in the archive reported rather than hidden. Postgres behind it, self-hostable.

plugins.name: srs
plugins.description: A tiny spaced-repetition stack shared by a minimal web app and an MCP server. Create, edit, search and review cards from chat, with FSRS scheduling and tags that reuse existing categories.
